integrity.claimed_result: New complete value formula and the sharp m=8 regime change for all m>=3; known general SDP and symmetry reductions acknowledged.
integrity.verification: Analytical spectral/convex proof; standalone script checks finite instances and symbolic identities, not the infinite family.

scientific_limitations: Exact SLEM optimization applies to symmetric nonnegative stochastic kernels on the one-edge-deleted balanced biclique; only the automorphism-invariant optimizer is shown unique, not every unrestricted optimizer. The m=2 path case is established prior work. The literature comparison does not establish absolute novelty.
title: Sharp eight-part transition for fastest mixing on a biclique with one deleted edge
